note:
ARGR_ECOLI N-term winged-helix DBD, 69 aa (= full ArgR 7-75). Candidate numbering is 1-based on the supplied 69-mer; verified every candidate's stated WT matches the query at that index.

CHANNELS
- ESM-2 650M masked-marginal: all 100 candidates (uniform coverage; used as the `ranking` score).
- PSSM + Shannon conservation from a 22-row query-anchored MSA (blast_msa call_id:2a71831dfb3a4c00a448c1931ddf1d56). Homologs are distant (~29-34% id), so MSA evidence is weak.
- ESM-IF1 on the supplied AF2 backbone, 18 finalists. Tool returns whole-sequence mean log-likelihood, so I report (variant - WT) x 69. WT mean LL = -1.4952999612559443 (call_id:d2de9cb87ee34326935f5a70d925aa76).

STRUCTURE CROSS-CHECK
AF2 reference vs independent ESMFold model: TM=0.939, RMSD 0.45 A over 66 res (call_id:57c3b919483c40f69624930874de4d58); ESMFold mean CA pLDDT 0.885. Two independent structure channels agree, so ESM-IF1 runs on a trustworthy backbone.

TOOL FAILURE (reported, not worked around)
dssp failed on BOTH the reference PDB (call_id:4347b81933ec4605a6241b7799e4201a) and the ESMFold artifact (call_id:bc7a93271b4d43dca9d676f25876b755): "did not start with a valid PDB HEADER line". I therefore have NO secondary-structure or solvent-exposure evidence. No burial/exposure claim appears anywhere in this analysis; any such claim would be unsupported.

NOT DONE
No ddG, no MD, no binding calculation, no measured fitness. openmm_snapshot_potential_delta deliberately unused: it compares unminimised snapshots, is not a ddG or variant ranker, and I had no mutant coordinates. pubmed_search unused; prior literature is not this assay's label. Everything below is model prediction.
